reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed fixed-design bulk RNA-seq negative-binomial treatment-minus-control inference at independent allocation level, with immutable workflow and source-difference audit; no executed data or predictive training task.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original RNA-seq Methods, supplements and release-specific validated tool/import protocols to select and verify transferable settings. Future source comparison or recording chosen settings is insufficient.
Input hashing and a sample schema are proposed, but no actual file-to-sample/pair/identity integrity validation gate is specified before inference.
No operational normalization, filtering and compatible quantifier/import workflow; placeholders for thresholds/tools do not explain how settings will be chosen.
Threshold placeholders are called calibration, but there is no reference/pilot-to-acceptance procedure or quantitative error/precision target.
The independent unit is correctly distinguished, but no pilot dispersion/effect-to-power/precision procedure determines required independent replication.
No selected primary test, complete eligible testing family or effect-uncertainty output rule, despite the BH label and contrast direction.
The named model is not developed into library offsets, mean/overdispersion assumptions or normalization limitations needed to interpret count changes.
No bounded parameter/sensitivity exploration with evaluation and lock.
No explicit refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after failed/ambiguous analysis and revisions.

A particular decreasing mean-dispersion curve is not a universal acceptance requirement for all valid NB data/fits. Diagnostics need an appropriate trend/model check, not rejection solely for a different valid shape.
No operational independent biological or orthogonal quantification/inference validation of the proposed contrast.
Git and input/container hashes are helpful, but exact resolved commands/settings/seeds, execution logs and complete sample-to-output provenance are missing.
No numerical tolerance or data-behind-plot comparison, resource/failure logs, or semantic source-difference procedure beyond hashes and rerunning a commit.

Primary route is prospectively specified count-contrast inference, not prediction or feature-selection performance assessment. Its blinded pilot/calibration and frozen confirmatory specification are described; predictive train/test leakage is not an additional deduction. Independent/orthogonal confirmation is assessed separately under P14.

Correctly distinguishes independently allocated wells from donors, states proposed status, protects allocation and identifies complete batch confounding. Much of the calibration and reproducibility detail remains placeholders without decision procedures, and the dispersion acceptance rule is too restrictive.
